title: Quarterly business review
body: QBR with Ravi Okafor. Four new product teams are moving onto the platform and usage is approaching the weekly quota. Ravi asked what a higher quota tier would cost and mentioned an upcoming acquisition that would add two more teams.

title: Re: Capacity planning
body: Ravi confirmed the data platform team will migrate their batch jobs next month, which should add roughly 15% to metered units.

title: Champion strong
body: Ravi is a vocal internal champion and presented the integration at their all-hands.

title: Check-in with data team lead
body: Helena Park said the analytics team was reorganised and two heavy users left. Seat logins may drop. She asked for a refresher training for the new analysts.

title: Expansion idea parked
body: Discussed adding a second business unit after the reorg settles.

title: Customer reports latency on batch API
body: Tomas Reyes wrote that batch API calls have been timing out since the last release and the platform team is frustrated. Support opened two high-priority tickets.

title: Roadmap sync
body: Tomas is happy with the core product but wants better rate limits and clearer usage reporting.

title: Quarterly sync
body: Gwen Alder mentioned budget pressure and that her sponsor is leaving the company next quarter. No follow-up booked.

title: Welcome back
body: Gwen confirmed the team reactivated two integrations.

title: Security questionnaire returned
body: Elliot Marsh's team returned the completed security questionnaire. SSO and SCIM requirements still need an owner on their side.

title: Renewal pre-read
body: Annika Voss said the logistics network expansion is going well and the team is happy. She expects to discuss renewal terms in December.

title: Executive sync
body: Annika wants to extend the platform to the new Rotterdam hub in Q1.

title: Invoice follow-up unanswered
body: Sent a reminder for invoice inv_tide2 to Samir Joshi. No reply; accounts payable contact is unknown.

title: Usage review
body: Samir said usage is stable and the team is satisfied.

title: Re: Minor feature request
body: Beatrix Lund asked for a CSV export of the weekly usage report.

title: Routine check-in
body: Everything is steady, no concerns raised.
